```{r}
 
dol <- function(ga, thetab, betaB, gb, betamin, gmin, mA, mB,
                thetaa, Pa, Pb, betaA, d, A0, B0, a0, b0, times) {

  library(deSolve)

  dol_equations <- function(time, variables, parameters) {
    with(as.list(c(variables, parameters)), {

      #dA <- A * (ga * thetab * gb * betaB * betamin * gmin - mA)
      #dB <- B * (gb * thetaa * ga * betaA * betamin * gmin - mB)
      dA <- A * (ga * thetab/(Kb + b) - mA)
      dB <- B * (gb * thetaa /(Ka + a) - mB)
      da <- A * Pa - A * ga - d * (A * thetaa - B * betaA * ga)
      db <- B * Pb - B * gb - d * (B * thetab - A * betaB * gb)

      list(c(dA, dB, da, db))
    })
  }

  parameters_values <- c(
    ga = ga, thetab = thetab, betaB = betaB, gb = gb,
    betamin = betamin, gmin = gmin, mA = mA, mB = mB,
    thetaa = thetaa, Pa = Pa, Pb = Pb, betaA = betaA, d = d
  )

  initial_values <- c(A = A0, B = B0, a = a0, b = b0)

  out <- ode(y = initial_values, times = times, func = dol_equations, parms = parameters_values)

  as.data.frame(out)
}

dol_values <- dol(
ga      = 0.05,
gb      = 0.1,
betaA   = 0.015,
betaB   = 0.08,
betamin = 0.001,
gmin    = 0.001,
mA      = 0.0001,
mB      = 0.0001,
d       = 0.1,
A0      = 100,
B0      = 100,
a0      = 0,
b0      = 0,
thetaa = .001,
thetab = .016,
Pa = .1,
Pb =.1,
times = seq(0,1000))


#Plot
ggplot(dol_values, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = A, color = "SpeciesA")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = B, color = "SpeciesB")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = a, color = "Resourcea")) +
  geom_line(aes(y=b, color = "Resourceb"))+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      SpeciesA = "blue",
      SpeciesB = "red",
      Resourcea = "black",
      Resourceb = "grey"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Abundance",
    color = NULL
  )
```

```{r}
sdir <- function(beta, gamma, deltaI, deltaR, muE, muI, D0, S0, I0, R0, times) { 
  require(deSolve) #set parameters beta, gamma, S0, I0, R0, and times (time of outbreak)
  
  sir_equations <- function(time, variables, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(variables, parameters)), {
    dS <- -beta * I * S - muE*S #S equation
    dD <-  muE*S+muI*I - D*deltaI -deltaR*D
    dI <-  beta * I * S - gamma * I+D*deltaI-I*(gamma+muI) #I equation
    dR <-  gamma * I +deltaR*D#R equation
    return(list(c(dS, dD, dI, dR)))
  })
  }
  
  parameters <- c(beta  = beta, gamma = gamma, deltaI = deltaI, deltaR=deltaR, muE=muE, muI=muI) #set parameter values

  val0 <- c(S = S0, I = I0, R = R0, D=D0) #initial starting conditions
  
  out <- ode(val0, times, sir_equations, parameters) #output of the solved ODE 
  
  as.data.frame(out)
}

sdir_values<-sdir(beta = 0.004, gamma = 0.5, deltaI=.01, deltaR=.001, muE= .004, muI=.004, D0=1, S0 = 999, I0 = 1, R0 = 0, times = seq(0, 30))
#sir_values<-c("beta = 0.05", "gamma = 0.25", "S0 = 1000", "I0 = 1", "R0 = 0", "Time = (0, 10)")


#Plot
ggplot(sdir_values, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = S, color = "susceptibles")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = D, color = "dormant")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = I, color = "infectious")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = R, color = "recovered")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      susceptibles = "blue",
      dormant ="black",
      infectious = "red",
      recovered = "green"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Number of Cases",
    color = NULL
  )
```
